title: 矽穿孔蝕刻與絕緣
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入TSV 孔形、絕緣覆蓋與漏電。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore tsv geometry, insulation coverage and leakage, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 孔洞架構
stages.description: 針對孔洞架構完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for via architecture, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: Via-first/middle/last｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Via-first/middle/last | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對Via-first/middle/last，把「形成時點決定可用熱預算與保護的既有結構。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For via-first/middle/last, turn "Insertion timing determines thermal budget and structures needing protection." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「Via-first/middle/last」的模型：形成時點決定可用熱預算與保護的既有結構。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「畫三條整合路徑和不可逆界面。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for via-first/middle/last: Insertion timing determines thermal budget and structures needing protection. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw three integration routes and irreversible interfaces. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫三條整合路徑和不可逆界面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw three integration routes and irreversible interfaces. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有 TSV 都可用相同熱預算。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Giving every TSV the same thermal budget. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付Via-first/middle/last的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for via-first/middle/last, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: Via-first/middle/last：機制
knowledge.text: 形成時點決定可用熱預算與保護的既有結構。
knowledge.textEn: Insertion timing determines thermal budget and structures needing protection.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 畫三條整合路徑和不可逆界面。 必須排除的錯判：所有 TSV 都可用相同熱預算。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Draw three integration routes and irreversible interfaces. Misinterpretation to reject: Giving every TSV the same thermal budget. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「矽穿孔蝕刻與絕緣」的「Via-first/middle/last｜機制與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「接合線：失蹤的良率」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Via-first/middle/last | mechanism and design” in “Through-silicon-via etching and insulation”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 在「Via-first/middle/last」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For via-first/middle/last — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 形成時點決定可用熱預算與保護的既有結構。
所有 TSV 都可用相同熱預算
平均膜厚可排除所有擊穿弱點
optionsEn: Insertion timing determines thermal budget and structures needing protection.
Giving every TSV the same thermal budget
Using average thickness to exclude breakdown weak spots
quiz.explanation: 形成時點決定可用熱預算與保護的既有結構。 畫三條整合路徑和不可逆界面。 因此不能採用「所有 TSV 都可用相同熱預算」。
quiz.explanationEn: Insertion timing determines thermal budget and structures needing protection. Draw three integration routes and irreversible interfaces. Therefore reject: Giving every TSV the same thermal budget.

steps.title: Via-first/middle/last｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Via-first/middle/last | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對Via-first/middle/last，把「形成時點決定可用熱預算與保護的既有結構。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For via-first/middle/last, turn "Insertion timing determines thermal budget and structures needing protection." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：畫三條整合路徑和不可逆界面。 將「所有 TSV 都可用相同熱預算」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Draw three integration routes and irreversible interfaces. Challenge the hypothesis "Giving every TSV the same thermal budget" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 畫三條整合路徑和不可逆界面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw three integration routes and irreversible interfaces. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有 TSV 都可用相同熱預算。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Giving every TSV the same thermal budget. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付Via-first/middle/last的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for via-first/middle/last: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

Use this evidence plan: Measure top/middle/bottom diameter. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.

steps.failure: 避免：入口孔徑足以描述整個 TSV。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.observation: 估最壞遮罩消耗和對位界限。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Estimate worst mask loss and overlay bounds. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：孔位對準就可忽略遮罩退縮。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Ignoring mask retreat after alignment passes. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付遮罩與保護區的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for mask and keep-outs: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 遮罩與保護區：機制
knowledge.text: 遮罩要承受深蝕刻且保護附近元件。
knowledge.textEn: Masks must survive deep etch while protecting nearby devices.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 估最壞遮罩消耗和對位界限。 必須排除的錯判：孔位對準就可忽略遮罩退縮。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate worst mask loss and overlay bounds. Misinterpretation to reject: Ignoring mask retreat after alignment passes. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「遮罩與保護區」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For mask and keep-outs — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 孔位對準就可忽略遮罩退縮
共形沉積名稱即保證全孔相同性質
估最壞遮罩消耗和對位界限。
optionsEn: Ignoring mask retreat after alignment passes
Treating a conformal-process label as proof of uniform properties
Estimate worst mask loss and overlay bounds.
quiz.explanation: 遮罩要承受深蝕刻且保護附近元件。 估最壞遮罩消耗和對位界限。 因此不能採用「孔位對準就可忽略遮罩退縮」。
quiz.explanationEn: Masks must survive deep etch while protecting nearby devices. Estimate worst mask loss and overlay bounds. Therefore reject: Ignoring mask retreat after alignment passes.
